text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-1452 fired for service hosted-inference-prod (us-west-2). severity=high, symptom=503 spike + latency tail, escalation_policy=prod-sre. Primary on-call: eli. Paging primary now.

pagerduty: Alert PD-1452 triggered: hosted-inference-prod - 503-rate > 1% over 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-1452

eli: saw the page. on commute, will try to ack from phone in a sec.

(2m passes)

incident-bot: No ack from primary within 2m; escalating to secondary: deepak.

deepak: getting page now, acked. Investigating logs and routing.

deepak: quick summary - spikes are concentrated on /v1/generate for long-context requests (~2k tokens). Error budget crossing for us-west-2. Seeing steady 10-12% 503s for that route.

morgan: tagging product - this looks customer impacting for a handful of high-traffic tenants. Are we seeing autoscale failures or runtime OOM?

deepak: not OOMs. Runtime logs show queue saturation on gpu-pool-3 and repeated kernel timeouts. Also a recent routing change rolled out ~04:14 that started sending some requests to gpu-pool-3 exclusively.

julia: i pushed that routing tweak. rolling it back now.

julia: rollback command:
```
# rollback routing policy
rkctl apply -f /configs/routing/hosted-inference-prod-rollout-2026-03-15-revert.yaml
```

incident-bot: Rollback applied by julia at 04:21 UTC.

deepak: after rollback, starting a graceful drain of gpu-pool-3 and shifting traffic across pools. Running: `infractl pool drain gpu-pool-3 --grace 30s`

ops-notify-bot: Notifying impacted customers with templated message id 7c3 - subject: brief outage notice.

(3m passes)

eli: ack now. totally missed the original PD page, phone didn't vibrate. sorry all. i can help coordinate the postmortem.

oncall-manager: Thanks for ack, eli. Good that deepak already took action. Two things: 1) why did primary not get the phone page? 2) confirm if manager escalation needed or resolved by rollback.

deepak: manager escalation got triggered automatically because secondary had an ack but the error rate persisted and the escalation timer fired for manager. oncall-manager was paged and i saw a voice call hit the manager escalation.

oncall-manager: I got the voice and joined the Slack thread. I requested temporary capacity increase and asked to keep manager on-call bridge open until we have stable error rate <0.1%.

morgan: can we quantify customer impact? deepak, ops-notify-bot, what tenants saw errors?

deepak: roughly 6 tenants saw >1% 503s, top one saw 8% errors for 04:10-04:24 UTC. Telemetry: request volume normal, error ratio peaked at 6.2% across region, latency p95 increased from 120ms -> 700ms.

ops-notify-bot: Customer notification sent to tenants: tenant-a, tenant-f, tenant-k. Incident contact set to oncall SRE.

julia: after rollback and drain, error rate trending down. GPU pool drain completed; traffic rebalanced.

deepak: monitoring shows 503s dropping to 0.4% over the last 2m. p95 down to ~150ms.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-1452 status: acknowledged by deepak, manager on-call (oncall-manager) paged and responded. Incident is being mitigated. Auto-escalation to manager occurred due to policy timer (no resolution within 10m of ack).

eli: action items for post-incident: - verify phone notification reliability for primary on-call (sms/voice gateway). - add canary delay for routing rollouts to avoid single-pool saturation. - add dashboard alarm to detect routing imbalance before 1% 503 threshold.

oncall-manager: agree. also request a follow-up runbook update: if routing change touches GPU pool affinity, block rollout if pool utilization >60%.

morgan: will open a follow-up ticket and assign owners. morgan -> alerting & runbooks; julia -> rollout gates; infra -> phone gateway check (eli to coordinate).

eli: i'm happy to coordinate the phone gateway check tomorrow morning. i couldn't receive the pager, so that's top priority.

deepak: resolution timeline: root cause = aggressive routing rollout that concentrated long-context requests to a single GPU pool causing queue saturation and timeouts. mitigation = rollback + pool drain + temporary capacity redistribution.

incident-bot: Closing note: PD-1452 will be resolved when error rate <0.1% sustained for 10m. Please update this thread with any follow-ups.

morgan: marking incident as mitigated for now. Planning postmortem for tomorrow. :thumbsup:

julia: adding notes to the rollback PR and tagging postmortem template.

eli: thanks everyone. i’ll post an update in the morning after the phone gateway check.

(END OF THREAD)
